correctness.rationale: Affine barycentric symmetry puts the solid and each partition section centroid at the equal-coordinate point; cap volumes are epsilon^n, separated from each section, and locally subtract k caps. Direct independent quadrature, exact rational tails and truncation checks in verify.py passed. Infinite dimensional parameter n is covered analytically rather than by finite tests.
